verified_public_capabilities: DAMOS documents manual morphology and syntax annotation, translation, lexical information, and multiple simultaneous analyses with probability/uncertainty.
DAMOS project literature documents an EpiDoc export implementation.
Current public/user-facing download capability does not establish a complete bulk linguistic-gold export.
accepted_artifact: Maintainer-provided or documented public EpiDoc/structured export retaining stable DAMOS identifiers, linguistic annotations, competing analyses, uncertainty/probability, and provenance.
not_accepted: treating conventional transliteration as graphical sign identity
